en.headline: Councillor inspects Hung Hom alley after footage shows rats beside restaurant
en.dek: District councillor Lam Tak-shing visited the Baker Circle site with the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department on Tuesday and called for stepped-up patrols and rodent control.

zh.headline: 區議員視察紅碩貝克圓環後巷鼠患 要求加強滅鼠
zh.dek: 林志成周二聯同食環署及商場管理人員到場，要求加強巡查後巷、垃圾房及排水渠，並定期滅鼠。

en.headline: Artists transform retired gas tanks into exhibition pieces in Sham Shui Po
en.dek: More than 20 artists rework blue LPG cylinders that once fuelled Hong Kong kitchens into contemporary works at The Bridge+ space, opening Wednesday.

zh.headline: 深水埗藝術展將退役石油氣罐變藝術品 周三開幕
zh.dek: 逾二十位藝術家把承載港人回憶的藍色石油氣罐重塑成當代作品，於The Bridge+空間展出至11月8日。

en.headline: Observatory issues Strong Monsoon Signal for easterly winds
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the signal at 4.45am on Wednesday, warning of mean winds exceeding 40 km/h from the east with occasional gale-force gusts.

zh.headline: 天文台發出強烈季候風信號 預料吹偏東強風
zh.dek: 天文台周三凌晨四時四十五分發出信號，預料本港吹偏東強風，平均風速每小時超過四十公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。

en.headline: Police arrest 56-year-old man over indecent assault at Tsing Yi MTR station
en.dek: Officers identified the suspect through CCTV after a woman reported being assaulted at the station on Sunday and detained him at a bus terminus on Tuesday.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕56歲男子 涉青衣港鐵站非禮
zh.dek: 事主周日報案指在青衣站被非禮，警方經閉路電視鎖定嫌疑，周二在巴士總站拘捕他。

en.headline: Hong Kong Food Carnival runs through 1 November with Halloween free entry
en.dek: The 13th edition at Kwai Chung Sports Ground features more than 330 booths across seven zones, with free admission for those in Halloween attire on 30 and 31 October.

zh.headline: 第十三屆香港美食嘉年華葵涌舉行至11月1日 萬聖夜穿主題服可免費入場
zh.dek: 廠商會主辦的嘉年華設逾330個撤位、七大主題區，10月30及31日穿至少兩件萬聖節元素服飾或妝容可免入場費。

en.headline: Food delivery rider injured in Yuen Long motorcycle collision
en.dek: A non-Chinese male rider suffered hand and leg abrasions after his motorcycle collided with a private car at a junction on Tuesday night.

zh.headline: 元朗私家車與外賣電單車相撞 送遞員手腳擦傷送院
zh.dek: 周二晚約十時，馬田路右轉入告由路的私家車與電單車相撞，非華裔男送遞員被拋出後擦傷，送博愛醫院時清醒。

en.headline: Hong Kong Asian Games athletes greet residents in Sha Tin bus parade
en.dek: Gold medallists in rowing and windsurfing joined teammates for an open-top bus tour organised with the Sha Tin Festival.

zh.headline: 亞運港隊運動員沙田開蓬巴士巡遊與居民見面
zh.dek: 賽艇及滑浪風帆金牌得主聯同其他獎牌得主，參與沙田節委員會與民政處合辦的巡遊活動。

en.headline: Court hears strike-out bid in Deliveroo rider’s compensation claim
en.dek: A former rider who suffered brain injuries seeks employees’ compensation, while the platform’s liquidator argues there was no employment relationship.

zh.headline: 戶戶送前外送員工傷索償案 法庭聽取剔除申請
zh.dek: 前外送員因交通意外頭部重創申請僱員補償，平台清盤人指雙方並無僱傭關係，法官押後裁決。

en.headline: Spooky Halloween music carnival returns to Wan Chai harbourfront this weekend
en.dek: Ne-Yo, MEOVV and local artists headline three nights of performances with large installations from 30 October.

zh.headline: 灣仔海濱「Spooky Halloween」音樂嘉年華本周末回歸
zh.dek: Ne-Yo、MEOVV及本地藝人將於10月30日起三晚演出，現場設大型裝置。

en.headline: Hong Kong crypto payments firm RedotPay weighs confidential US IPO
en.dek: Bloomberg reported the unicorn is considering a year-end filing and pre-IPO talks at a valuation of US$4 billion to US$5 billion.

zh.headline: 港產加密支付獨角獸RedotPay據報考慮年底前保密赴美上市
zh.dek: 彭博引述知情人士稱，公司正商討上市前融資，估值或介乎40億至50億美元。

en.headline: Lawmakers question HK$27 billion funding request for San Tin Technopole works
en.dek: The Development Bureau seeks approval for site formation, a wetland park and an effluent plant as part of the second stage of the border tech hub.

zh.headline: 議員關注新田科技城第二階段約272億元撥款申請
zh.dek: 發展局向立法會申請撥款，涵蓋土地平整、三寶樹濕地保育公園及淨水設施，作為科技城第二階段工程。

en.headline: Beautician jailed four years for selling friends to Myanmar scam compound
en.dek: District Court Judge Adriana Noelle Tse Ching described the defendant’s actions as vicious and inhumane after the two women were held for ransom.

zh.headline: 美容師誘騙友人賣至緬甸詐騙園區 判囚四年
zh.dek: 區域法院法官謝沈智慧斥被告行為夕毒及泯滅人性，兩名事主被困近兩周後家人支付贖金才獲釋。

en.headline: Customs seize HK$10 million in illicit cigarettes from speedboat in southeast waters
en.dek: Officers intercepted a high-powered speedboat without navigation lights off the Ninepin Group early on Tuesday and arrested two mainland men.

zh.headline: 海關東南水域截大馬力快艇 檢約一千萬元私煙拘兩人
zh.dek: 關員於果洲群島東南對開截停沒有開啟航行燈的快艇，拘捕兩名內地男子，檢獲約223萬支懷疑私煙。

en.headline: Housing officer admits misconduct for falsely claiming approvals
en.dek: A 36-year-old Housing Department estate officer pleaded guilty at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts to misconduct in public office after failing to submit two applications.

zh.headline: 房署主任承認公職人員行為失當 誝稱加戶及活動申請獲批
zh.dek: 36歲房屋事務主任在西九龍裁判法院承認控罪，案件押後至11月10日判刑，須賠償約3.4萬元。

en.headline: Water supply resumes in Shau Kei Wan and parts of Sai Wan Ho from 9.30pm
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department said emergency repairs to the damaged main on Shau Kei Wan Road were completed, with supply returning progressively from 9.30pm on Tuesday.

zh.headline: 筱箕灣及部分西灣河食水供應晚上九時半起陸續恢復
zh.dek: 水務署表示，筱箕灣道受損食水管的緊急維修工程已完成，周二晚上九時半起供水陸續恢復正常。

en.headline: John Lee says Northern Metropolis university towns aim to attract world's finest scholars
en.dek: Speaking at the Global University Presidents and Leaders Summit, the Chief Executive invited institutions to set up research platforms and strengthen industry-academia links.

zh.headline: 李家超：北都大學城旨在吸引全球頂尖學者及學生
zh.dek: 行政長官在全球大學校長及領袖高峰會致辭，邀請機構設立研究平台，加強產學研聯繫，三個大學城連同周邊發展面積逾1000公頃。

en.headline: Police arrest two drivers over cross-border illegal passenger services
en.dek: Officers posing as passengers booked luxury seven-seaters via social media for trips to Shenzhen, leading to the arrest of a 33-year-old local man and a 27-year-old mainland man on a two-way permit.

zh.headline: 警方放蛇打擊跨境白牌車 拘捕本地及持雙程證司機
zh.dek: 港島總區交通部人員喬裝乘客，經社交平台預約豪華七人車前往深圳，成功拘捕一名33歲本地男子及一名27歲持雙程證內地男子。

en.headline: Hang Seng closes down 170 points at 23041 after high open
en.dek: The index finished 0.73 per cent lower with turnover of HK$178.3 billion. HSBC shares fell more than 5 per cent after third-quarter results while tech and property stocks also weakened.

zh.headline: 恒指收跌170點報23041點
zh.dek: 指數高開低走，全日成交約1783億元。滙控季績後挫逾5%，科技及內房股偏弱，智譜逆市升近9%。

en.headline: Three-vehicle crash on Kwai Chung Road injures at least nine including pregnant woman
en.dek: Police said a light goods vehicle, a medium goods vehicle and a green minibus collided near Yam Hop Hing Industrial Building shortly after 9.11am; the injured were treated and taken to hospital while lanes were closed.

zh.headline: 葵涌道三車相撞至少九人受傷包括孕婦
zh.dek: 警方表示上午約9時11分接報，輕型貨車、中型貨車及綠色專線小巴在任合興工業大廈對開相撞，傷者送院，部分行車線封閉。

en.headline: MTR says linked faults caused two Lam Tin disruptions in mid-October
en.dek: Preliminary findings point to a failed insulating component that sparked a fire on 13 October and an overloaded connection the next morning; the operator must submit a full report within a month.

zh.headline: 港鐵指藍田站兩次事故由相關故障引致
zh.dek: 初步調查顯示10月13日絕緣膠失效引致短路起火，翌日接地開關未重置令電纜過載冒煙；政府要求一個月內提交詳細報告。

en.headline: Pipe burst cuts water to parts of Eastern district after Shau Kei Wan works
en.dek: Supply was suspended from 11am in Sai Wan Ho, Shau Kei Wan, Aldrich Bay and nearby areas; authorities aim to restore it before midnight. An elderly care-home resident was injured.

zh.headline: 笮箕灣道路工程爆水管 東區部分地區停水至午夜前
zh.dek: 水務署自上午11時起暫停西灣河、笮箕灣、愛秩序灣及阿公岩道至香島一帶食水供應，目標午夜前恢復。安老院舍一名院友腳傷。

en.headline: Police arrest three over Tseung Kwan O wounding possibly linked to illicit fuel
en.dek: The three men, aged 16 to 19 and with suspected triad backgrounds, were arrested after a 35-year-old driver was stabbed last week at the industrial estate.

zh.headline: 將軍澳工業區傷人案 警拘三名涉三合會背景青年
zh.dek: 三名16至19歲男子涉嫌串謀意圖傷人被捕，事主為35歲輕型貨車司機，上周三在駿日街遭襲，車上檢獲約120公升懷疑私油。

en.headline: CUHK to bid for land in Hung Shui Kiu University Town
en.dek: Vice-Chancellor Dennis Lo said the university plans to compete for one of the first sites, citing expansion opportunities despite staggered tenders and high costs.

zh.headline: 中大擬競投洪水橋大學城首批土地
zh.dek: 校長盧煜明表示大學計劃競投其中一個首批校舍用地，認為是擴大校園的機會，惟分批招標及成本高昂構成挑戰。

en.headline: HSBC third-quarter pretax profit rises 32 per cent to US$9.6 billion
en.dek: The result matched analyst expectations. The bank also announced a further share buy-back of up to US$1 billion and a third interim dividend of 10 US cents.

zh.headline: 滙豐第三季除稅前利潤增32%至96億美元
zh.dek: 業績大致符合市場預期，銀行宣布最多10億美元股份回購及每股0.1美元第三次中期息。

en.headline: Privacy watchdog investigates data breaches at three firms affecting over 1,600
en.dek: The Office of the Privacy Commissioner confirmed notifications from Hong Kong Airlines, YOHO Hong Kong and Broadway Photo, and has received 23 complaints so far.

zh.headline: 私隱專員公署調查三間公司資料外洩 涉逾1600名市民
zh.dek: 公署證實接獲香港航空、友和香港及百老滙通報，至今共收到23宗投訴及20宗查詢，已展開調查。

en.headline: Customs seize 3kg of cannabis buds from Bangkok arrival at airport
en.dek: A 56-year-old mainland man was arrested after officers found the suspected cannabis and other items in his carry-on baggage.

zh.headline: 海關機場截查曼谷抵港旅客 檢約3公斤大麻花
zh.dek: 一名56歲內地男子被捕，人員在其手提行李發現懷疑大麻花及其他物品。

en.headline: Ocean Park Halloween Fest continues through 1 November with Grave Rave experiences
en.dek: Daytime access runs until 1 November while selected night sessions feature the Under the Castle haunted experience linked to Jackson Wang’s fantasy IP.

zh.headline: 海洋公園哈囉喂全園祭持續至11月1日 以詭魅墓會為主題
zh.dek: 日間體驗至11月1日，指定晚間場次設有王嘉爾原創奇幻IP「Under the Castle」驚嚇體驗。

en.headline: Customs and firefighters dismantle illegal petrol station near Man Kam To homes
en.dek: Officers seized about 1,560 litres of duty-not-paid petrol and arrested a 33-year-old man after finding a fenced shed on Man Kam To Road.

zh.headline: 海關消防搗破文錦渡民居附近非法加油站
zh.dek: 人員在文錦渡路檢獲約1560公升未完稅汽油，並拘捕一名33歲男子。

en.headline: Police arrest 20-year-old over alleged HK$81,000 theft at Tuen Mun 7-Eleven
en.dek: The employer reported the money missing on Monday evening after checking the cash balance and reviewing transaction records that showed transfers to electronic wallets.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕20歲男子 涉屯門7-Eleven盜竊逾8萬元
zh.dek: 店主周一傍晚報案，指現金短少約8.1萬元，交易紀錄顯示有款項轉入電子錢包。

en.headline: Development Bureau proposes twin landmark towers and more homes at Hung Hom harbourfront
en.dek: The revised plan raises total floor area by 3 per cent to 206,500 square metres, with residential share at 62 per cent, and cancels four waterfront residential blocks for open space.

zh.headline: 發展局建議紅礎海濱建雙塔地標 增加住宅比例
zh.dek: 修訂方案將總樓面增至約20.65萬平方米，住宅佔約62%，臨海四幢住宅改作公眾休憩用地，目標2029年初交地。

en.headline: Hong Kong Wine & Dine Festival returns to Central Harbourfront from 29 October
en.dek: The four-day event organised by the Tourism Board features more than 340 booths, new country pavilions and a Maxim’s food street marking the group’s 70th anniversary.

zh.headline: 香港美酒佳養巡禮10月29日起中環海濱舉行
zh.dek: 旅發局主辦的四日活動設逾340攤位，首設澳洲、加拿大及韓國展館，並有美心集團70周年美食街。

en.headline: Middle-aged engineer loses HK$8.5 million in online romance scam
en.dek: Police said at least 18 romance scam reports were received in the past week with total losses exceeding HK$13 million, including this case involving a fake Taiwanese dancer.

zh.headline: 中年工程師墮網上情緣騙局 損失逾850萬元
zh.dek: 警方表示過去一周接獲至少18宗網上情緣騙案，總損失逾1,300萬元，其中一宗涉假冒台灣舞者。

en.headline: Authorities step up traffic management at Huanggang Port after weekend gridlock
en.dek: Police will open buffer zones and strengthen controls near the revamped crossing ahead of expected Halloween and concert peaks.

zh.headline: 當局加強皇崗口岸交通管理 應對周末擠塞
zh.dek: 警方將視車流開設緩衝區並加強管制，以應對萬聖節及演唱會預期人流車流高峰。

en.headline: Halloween installations light up Statue Square Gardens through 31 October
en.dek: The Central takeover features nightly illuminated displays from 4pm to 11:30pm, with special events on Chater Road on selected dates including Halloween night.

zh.headline: 萬聖狂歡祭中環裝置亮燈至10月31日
zh.dek: 皇后像廣場花園每晙4時至11時30分設有亮燈裝置，遮打道於包括萬聖節當晚在內的指定日子有特別活動。

en.headline: Customs seize 120,000 illicit cigarettes in Mong Kok flat
en.dek: Officers arrested a 46-year-old man after finding the stock in a subdivided unit used as a storage point.

zh.headline: 海關旺角破私煙倉 檢約12萬支私煙拘一人
zh.dek: 海關周一在旺角一割房檢獲約12萬支懷疑私煙，市值約54萬元，一名46歲男子被捕並已落案起訴。

en.headline: HK Electric cuts November fuel adjustment charge by 4.2 cents
en.dek: The average net tariff falls 2.2 per cent to 183 cents per kilowatt-hour, reflecting fuel costs from July to September under the deferral mechanism.

zh.headline: 港燈下調11月燃料調整費4.2仙 淨電費跌2.2%
zh.dek: 11月平均淨電費為每度183仙，主要反映7至9月燃料成本；中電同期則上調1.2仙至47.4仙。

en.headline: Firefighters rescue two workers stranded on Jardine House facade after gondola fault
en.dek: The suspended platform malfunctioned around 6:15pm on Monday evening, leaving the men dangling from harnesses near the 30th and 40th floors until about 8pm.

zh.headline: 中環怡和大廈吊船故障 兩工人被困半空消防游繩救出
zh.dek: 周一傍晚約6時15分吊船疑故障下墜，兩名外牆維修工人分別困於約30樓及40樓高度，靠安全帶牽引，至約晚上8時獲救。

en.headline: EVOKE Festival stages open-air electronic music on Hung Hom harbourfront this Halloween
en.dek: The event runs from 4pm to 10:30pm on 31 October at the New Hung Hom Harbourfront, with an after-party continuing until 4am.

zh.headline: EVOKE音樂節萬聖節登陸紅磡新海濱 主打戶外電音
zh.dek: 活動於10月31日下午4時至晚上10時30分在紅磡新海濱舉行，之後派對延至凌晨4時。

en.headline: M+ surveys two centuries of Asian fantasy art until next April
en.dek: More than 400 works fill the West Kowloon museum’s special exhibition on myths, monsters and popular culture, open since mid-October.

zh.headline: M+「神話與怪獸」展出逾400件亞洲奇幻作品 展期至明年四月
zh.dek: 西九文化區博物館特別展覽自十月中開放，涵蓋十九至二十一世紀神話、怪獸及流行文化。

en.headline: Lawmaker calls for closer Greater Bay Area airport cooperation
en.dek: Kenneth Fok said Hong Kong International Airport passenger numbers remain below pre-pandemic levels and urged government-to-government deals with mainland airports.

zh.headline: 議員促加強大灣區機場合作
zh.dek: 霍啟剛表示香港國際機場客運量仍未回復疫前水平，呼籲政府與內地機場進行政府間協議。

en.headline: HKMA says 280 global financial leaders to gather in Hong Kong next week
en.dek: Eddie Yue said the fifth Global Financial Leaders’ Investment Summit from 2 to 4 November will focus on rethinking the playbook for markets and technology.

zh.headline: 金管局：約280位國際金融領袖下周聚港
zh.dek: 余偉文表示，第五屆國際金融領袖投資峰會將於11月2日至4日舉行，主題圍繞市場與科技的「思變圖新」。

en.headline: Shek Kwu Chau waste facility fire largely extinguished after four hours
en.dek: Firefighters brought the No. 3 alarm blaze at I·PARK1 under control by mid-afternoon, with about 930 people evacuated and one worker treated for discomfort.

zh.headline: 石鼓洲焚化設施三級火約四小時後大致救熄
zh.dek: 消防下午將I·PARK1三級火受控並大致救熄，約930人自行疏散，一人不適送院。

en.headline: Civil Service Bureau outlines five-year training plan with AI and patriotic education
en.dek: Secretary for the Civil Service Ingrid Yeung told lawmakers the Continuous Learning Scheme for senior officials will expand to mid-level managers within two years.

zh.headline: 公務員事務局闡述五年培訓計劃 加強愛國及人工智能教育
zh.dek: 公務員事務局局長楊何蓓茵向立法會議員表示，持續學習計劃將於兩年內由高級公務員推展至中級管理人員。

en.headline: Eco Expo Asia 2026 opens at AsiaWorld-Expo with new ASEAN Pavilion
en.dek: The four-day trade fair, co-organised by the HKTDC and the Environment and Ecology Bureau, runs until 29 October under the theme Connecting the World for a Sustainable Future.

zh.headline: 國際環保博覽2026今起亞洲國際博覽館開幕 設東盟展館
zh.dek: 由貿發局與環境及生態局合辦的四日展會以「連接世界 共建可持續未來」為主題，展期至29日，最後一日設公眾日免費入場。

en.headline: Hang Seng closes up 118 points as property and oil stocks lead
en.dek: The index ended Monday at 23,211.81, a 0.51 per cent gain, with mainland banks and oil counters strong while technology and AI hardware shares lagged.

zh.headline: 港股高收 118點 地產內銀及三桶油造好
zh.dek: 恒生指數周一收報23211點，升幅0.51%，地產及內銀股領先，科技及人工智能硬件股份則偏弱。

en.headline: Lee honours Hong Kong athletes for record Asian Games medal haul
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee presented certificates to top performers at a Monday ceremony after the team won 11 golds and 54 medals in total at the Aichi-Nagoya Games.

zh.headline: 李家超嘉許亞運港隊創紀錄獎牌表現
zh.dek: 行政長官周一舉行嘉許禮，向名古屋亞運表現卓越的運動員頒發證書，港隊共奪11金、54面獎牌。

en.headline: COVID vaccine for children arrives, free jabs start Thursday
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the Spikevax XFG mRNA vaccine for ages six months to 11 years is in Hong Kong, with booking opening at noon tomorrow.

zh.headline: 供兒童接種新冠疫苗抵港 周四起免費接種
zh.dek: 衛生防護中心表示，供6個月至11歲兒童使用的Spikevax XFG疫苗已運抵本港，市民可明日中午起預約。

en.headline: Customs seize HK$33 million in suspected smuggled goods from river boats
en.dek: Officers intercepted two vessels bound for Macau on October 9 and 13, finding about 740,000 suspected pharmaceutical items among the undeclared cargo.

zh.headline: 海關破兩宗內河船走私案 檢值約3300萬元貨物
zh.dek: 海關本月9日及13日抽查兩艘往澳門的內河船，檢獲包括約74萬件懷疑藥劑製品在內的未列艙單貨物。

en.headline: Northern Metropolis Marathon draws 15,000 as traffic plans announced
en.dek: The Heung Yee Kuk’s first marathon on 1 November will close sections of roads including Lung Shan Tunnel and Fanling Bypass, with early MTR services arranged.

zh.headline: 北都馬拉松吸引約1.5萬人 當局公布交通安排
zh.dek: 鄉議局11月1日首辦北部都會區馬拉松，龍山隧道及粉嶺繞道部分路段將臨時封閉，港鐵提早開出首班車。

en.headline: SFC clears first secondary trading of tokenised public funds
en.dek: Two ChinaAMC tokenised money market funds began around-the-clock secondary trading on a licensed virtual asset platform on Monday, in a first for public funds.

zh.headline: 證監會批准首批代幣化基金二級市場交易
zh.dek: 兩隻華夏基金代幣化貨幣市場基金周一起於持牌虛擬資產平台提供全日制二級市場交易，屬公募基金首次。

en.headline: Firefighters battle level-three fire at Shek Kwu Chau waste facility
en.dek: A fire broke out at the Integrated Waste Management Facility Phase 1 on an artificial island near Shek Kwu Chau on Monday afternoon, with no injuries reported as crews fought the blaze.

zh.headline: 石鼓洲焚化設施三級火 消防灌救暫無傷亡
zh.dek: 周一中午石鼓洲附近人工島上的綜合廢物管理設施第一期發生火警，消防升為三級，暫未接獲受傷報告。

en.headline: Lee says Hong Kong can mobilise multi-currency capital for green projects
en.dek: At the first Belt and Road Green Innovation Conference held in the city, the Chief Executive announced a green technology bridgehead plan and a supercharging demonstration station for next year.

zh.headline: 李家超：香港可跨貨幣動員資本支持綠色發展
zh.dek: 一帶一路綠色創新大會首度在港舉行，行政長官宣布明年推出綠色科技橋頭堡計劃及超級充電技術示範站。

en.headline: CUHK study finds electroacupuncture eases tinnitus in middle-aged adults
en.dek: A trial of 90 patients aged 50 to 70, commissioned by Pok Oi Hospital, reported lower loudness scores and more than half moving from moderate to mild after five weeks of treatment.

zh.headline: 中大研究：電針可減輕中老年耳鳴困擾
zh.dek: 博愛醫院委託中大中醫學院進行的研究招募90名50至70歲患者，五周療程後耳鳴響度評分下降，逾半由中度改善至輕度。

en.headline: New Wah Fu Estate phase one set to finish six years early in 2034
en.dek: Housing Authority paper to Southern District Council says earlier land release allows about 1,760 units in three blocks by the second half of 2034 for phase-three residents.

zh.headline: 新華富邨第一期預計提早六年於2034年落成
zh.dek: 房委會向南區區議會提交文件，指華安樓及華樂樓用地可提早釋放，第一期約1760個單位預計2034年下半年入伙，供第三期居民使用。

en.headline: M+ Myths and Monsters exhibition continues through April at West Kowloon
en.dek: The special show tracing 200 years of fantasy imagery across Asia, from 19th-century mythology to manga and digital culture, remains on view at the museum until 4 April 2027.

zh.headline: M+「神話與怪獸」展覽延續至明年4月 西九展出亞洲奇幻視覺文化
zh.dek: 博物館特別展覽橫跨200年亞洲奇幻影像，由十九世紀神話到漫畫及數碼文化，展期至2027年4月4日。

en.headline: Warehouse worker bitten by dog after chase by three animals in Yuen Long
en.dek: A 26-year-old man suffered a minor calf wound around 8am on Monday when one of three warehouse dogs bit him near Kam Tin Road; Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department staff took the dog for checks.

zh.headline: 元朗貨倉男工被三隻倉狗追趕咬傷小腿送院
zh.dek: 周一早上約8時，26歲男倉務員在錦壐路附近被三隻狗追趕，其中一隻咬傷左小腿，傷勢輕微，漁護署人員已將涉事狗隻帶走檢查。

en.headline: Medical products regulator head pledges independent path, not mini-FDA
en.dek: Li Zili says the new centre will use Hong Kong’s strategic position and mainland drug pipelines to earn global trust while focusing on areas such as rare diseases.

zh.headline: 藥械監管總監李自力強調獨立路線 非縮小版FDA
zh.dek: 李自力表示，新中心將善用香港策略位置及內地藥品研發管線，建立國際信任，並聚焦罕見病等領域。

en.headline: Insurance Authority moves to tighten oversight of premium financing market
en.dek: The regulator says aggressive marketing and high leverage have drawn middle-class buyers into arrangements once limited to high-net-worth clients, and a joint inspection with the HKMA continues.

zh.headline: 保監局加強保費融資市場監管 指高槓桿及進取推廣存風險
zh.dek: 監管局表示，進取市場推廣及高槓桿吸引中產買家，與金管局聯合查察預計年底完成。

en.headline: Henderson Land marks 50 years with first pavilion at Wine and Dine Festival
en.dek: The developer will open a 2,000-square-foot space designed by Zaha Hadid Architects at the Central Harbourfront from 29 October, featuring limited dishes from 12 group restaurants.

zh.headline: 恒基地產50周年首設展館參與美酒佳餚巡禮
zh.dek: 發展商將於10月29日起在中環海濱設立約2000平方呎空間，由Zaha Hadid Architects設計，集合旗下12間餐廳限定菜式。

en.headline: Former HKU medicine vice-dean joins HKUST medical school as senior associate dean
en.dek: Anskar Leung Yu-hung, a haematology professor who has researched acute myeloid leukaemia, is among the academics formally joining the city’s third medical school.

zh.headline: 前港大醫學院副院長梁如鴻加入科大醫學院出任高級副院長
zh.dek: 血液學教授梁如鴻長期研究急性髓系白血病，成為正式加入本港第三所醫學院的學者之一。

en.headline: Interpol seeks silver notice approval at Hong Kong general assembly
en.dek: The organisation will ask member countries to endorse a new system for tracing criminals’ assets during its first assembly hosted in the city next month.

zh.headline: 國際刑警將於香港大會尋求通過銀通知追蹤犯罪資產
zh.dek: 組織將於下月首次在港舉行的全體大會上，請成員國批准新系統，協助追查跨司法管轄區的犯罪資產。

en.headline: Hongkong Land lights up Statue Square with Halloween installations through month end
en.dek: Four large free installations, including a giant eyeball over the fountain, illuminate nightly until 31 October as part of the Central event.

zh.headline: 置地公司於皇后像廣場設置萬聖裝置至月底
zh.dek: 包括噴水池旁巨型眼球在內的四個大型免費裝置每晚亮燈，活動至10月31日。

en.headline: PolyU aims for 50-50 overseas to mainland student ratio among non-locals
en.dek: President Teng Jin-guang said the university enrolled about 1,000 non-local students this year at a 40-60 split and plans new hostels to support greater internationalisation.

zh.headline: 理大目標非本地生海外與內地比例達五五分
zh.dek: 校長滕錦光表示，今年取錄約1000名非本地生，海外與內地生約四六分，並計劃興建新宿舍支援國際化。

en.headline: Man found hanged at Lok Ma Chau village house, confirmed dead at scene
en.dek: Police responded to a report about 11pm on Sunday that a 35-year-old man surnamed Sin had hanged himself with a rope in a room; no suicide note was found and the cause of death is pending autopsy.

zh.headline: 落馬洲米埔村屋35歲男子疑上吊 現場證實不治
zh.dek: 周日晚上約11時，有人報案指青山公路米埔段一村屋有男子上吊，消防到場解下35歲冼姓男子後證實死亡，現場無遺書，死因待驗屍確定。

en.headline: Woman loses HK$349,000 in jewellery and cash after Yuen Long village house burglary
en.dek: A 68-year-old resident of a Fairview Park house on Pinery Road South reported a door prised open late on Sunday, with watches, gold and cash missing; police have classified the case as burglary.

zh.headline: 元朗錦繡花園村屋遭爆竊 68歲女戶主失約34.9萬元財物
zh.dek: 周日晚上約11時，松濤南路一間村屋68歲侯姓女住戶報案指門被撬開，屋內有搜掠痕跡，失物包括手錶、金粒、頸鏈及現金，警方列爆竊案跟進。

en.headline: Police hunt former domestic helper after HK$600,000 jewellery theft in Mid-Levels
en.dek: A 56-year-old woman reported necklaces, bracelets and rings missing from her Robinson Road flat on Sunday evening; police are seeking a 37-year-old former helper who held a Hong Kong identity card.

zh.headline: 半山羅便臣道單位失竊約60萬元首飾 警追紗37歲前外傭
zh.dek: 56歲女戶主周日傍晚報案指羅便臣道單位內頸鏈、手鏈及戒指等首飾失蹤，警方正追紗一名37歲持香港身份證的前菲律賓籍外傭。

en.headline: Man dies after fall during police raid on Mong Kok tenement unit
en.dek: Organised Crime and Triad Bureau officers broke into a flat on Reclamation Street on Sunday night; a man believed to have tried to climb out a window was found unconscious and later died, and 21 people were taken for…

zh.headline: 旺角新填地街警方行動期間男子疑爬窗墮樓不治 21人被帶走調查
zh.dek: 有組織罪案及三合會調查科人員周日晚上破門搜查新填地街唐樓單位，一名男子懷疑企圖爬窗離開時失足墮樓，送廣華醫院搶救後不治，警方帶走21人調查。

en.headline: Two injured in three-car crash on Tai Po Ting Kok Road after wrong-way vehicle
en.dek: A private car travelling the wrong way collided head-on with another near Lei Pik Shan early Sunday, causing a third vehicle to hit the rear; two drivers were taken to hospital.

zh.headline: 大埔汀角路三車相撞兩人受傷 有司機疑逆線行駛
zh.dek: 周日凌晨約1時，大埔汀角路近犁壁山有私家車疑逆線行駛，與對向車輛迎頭相撞，尾隨車輛再撞前車車尾，兩名司機受傷送院。

en.headline: Tai Kwun stages FRAMED Halloween nights in Central later this week
en.dek: The heritage compound will host free art-inspired costume events in the Prison Yard on 30 and 31 October from 7pm to 10pm.

zh.headline: 大館下周舉行FRAMED藝裝萬聖夜
zh.dek: 中環大館將於10月30及31日晚上7時至10時在監獄操場免費舉辦藝術服裝主題活動，邀請訪客化身活藝術品。

en.headline: Outdoor and Tech Light Expo opens today at AsiaWorld-Expo
en.dek: The HKTDC fair runs through Thursday for industry visitors, featuring smart outdoor lighting solutions and concurrent with the autumn lighting fair starting tomorrow.

zh.headline: 香港國際戶外及科技照明博覽今日亞洲博覽館開幕
zh.dek: 貿發局主辦的業界展覽至周四舉行，展示智能戶外照明方案，入場限18歲或以上業內人士，明日起同期有秋季燈飾展。

en.headline: 91-year-old man dies after suspected choking at Ap Lei Chau care home
en.dek: Staff at a home on Lee Chi Road reported that a resident surnamed Kwok lost consciousness while eating wonton vermicelli on Sunday afternoon; he was taken to Queen Mary Hospital but later died.

zh.headline: 鴨脳洲院舍91歲翁疑食雲吞米線鯁喉 送院搶救後不治
zh.dek: 周日下午約5時43分利枝道院舍職員報案，指姓郭院友進食時疑鯁喉昏迷，送往瑪麗醫院後宣告不治，死因待驗屍確定。

en.headline: HK Express passenger suffers minor burn after power bank overheats on Jeju flight
en.dek: Crew placed the device in a fire containment bag and submerged it in water after smoke appeared under a seat as the aircraft approached the airport, and the plane landed safely.

zh.headline: 香港快運飛濟州航班行動電源過熱冒煙 女乘客拇指輕微灼傷
zh.dek: 飛機接近濟州機場時，座位下方行動電源冒煙，機組人員即時放入防火袋並浸水，航班安全降落，傷者拒絕救護車自行求醫。

en.headline: Firefighters extinguish unit fire in Yau Ma Tei Temple Street tong lau
en.dek: The blaze in a flat at 107-109 Temple Street was put out in about 17 minutes on Sunday evening after reports of smoke, with no injuries reported and a cooking stove initially suspected.

zh.headline: 油麻地廟街唐樓單位起火 消防約17分鐘撲熄無人傷
zh.dek: 周日晚上約9時38分廟街107至109號樓上單位冒煙，消防開喉及煙帽隊灌救，約17分鐘將火撲熄，初步懷疑煮食爐肇禍。

en.headline: Customs seize 2.2kg suspected cocaine at airport, charge mainland man
en.dek: A 39-year-old passenger from Penang was arrested after officers found the drugs in his carry-on baggage, and he will appear in court tomorrow.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲2.2公斤懷疑可卡因 拘捕內地漢
zh.dek: 一名39歲從檳城抵港的男乘客手提行李藏毒被捕，已遭控以販運危險藥物，周一提堂。

en.headline: John Catlin wins Hong Kong Open by five shots at Fanling
en.dek: The American closed with a six-under 64 to finish at 20 under, while local player Matthew Cheung tied for second in the best finish by a Hong Kong golfer in the event’s history.

zh.headline: 美國選手卡特林以五桿優勢贏得香港公開賽
zh.dek: 他決賽日打出低於標準六桿的64桿，總成績低於標準二十桿；本地球員張雄熙並列亞軍，創港將歷來最佳成績。

en.headline: Huanggang checkpoint sees overnight queues after concert and Halloween events
en.dek: Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki instructed departments to ensure smooth flow after footage showed long vehicle queues at the 24-hour crossing.

zh.headline: 皇崗口岸深夜至凌晨車流人流倍增 陳國基指示確保暢順
zh.dek: 啟德演唱會及萬聖活動後大批旅客經新皇崗北返，網上片段見車輛輪候，政務司司長已視察並指示保安局跟進。

en.headline: Veteran stock commentator Louie Shum dies at 66
en.dek: Former Sincere Securities chief Louie Shum Chun-ying collapsed near a taxi rank in Wan Chai and died on Saturday night at Ruttonjee Hospital, his family confirmed.

zh.headline: 資深股評人沈振盈逝世 享年66歲
zh.dek: 前訊匯證券行政總裁沈振盈（沈大師）周六晚在灣仔的士站附近暈倒，於律敦治醫院離世，家人周日證實。

en.headline: First six batches of key enterprises invest HK$28.3 billion
en.dek: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said actual investment by the first six batches reached HK$28.3 billion by end-September, exceeding phased targets, with 142 firms now in total.

zh.headline: 首六批重點企業實際投資達283億元
zh.dek: 財政司司長陳茂波表示，截至九月底首六批重點企業實際投資達283億港元、聘用逾1.03萬人，超階段目標；連同第七批合計142家。

en.headline: Firefighters battle hill fire near Tuen Mun residential estates
en.dek: Crews continued fighting a blaze on Por Lo Shan near Shan King Estate on Sunday afternoon, with a Government Flying Service helicopter dropping water and no injuries reported.

zh.headline: 屯門菠蘿山山火近屋苑 消防直升機灑水撲救
zh.dek: 周日下午屯門菠蘿山近山景邨一帶山火持續，消防處調派政府飛行服務隊直升機灑水協助，暫無人員受傷報告。

en.headline: AIIB expresses interest in financing Northern Metropolis projects
en.dek: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank is keen on infrastructure development in the Northern Metropolis and will explore cooperation when specific projects are identified.

zh.headline: 亞投行有興趣為北部都會區項目提供融資
zh.dek: 財政司司長陳茂波表示，亞洲基礎設施投資銀行對北部都會區基建發展甚有興趣，當有具體項目時會探討合作方式。

en.headline: Talent schemes draw 690,000 applications with 320,000 arrivals
en.dek: Chief Secretary Eric Chan said Hong Kong received about 690,000 applications under various talent admission schemes by September, with 320,000 people already arriving.

zh.headline: 各項人才計劃接獲約69萬宗申請 32萬人已抵港
zh.dek: 政務司司長陳國基表示，截至九月，特區政府各項人才計劃收到約69萬宗申請，約32萬人已抵港。

en.headline: Work week starts mainly fine, turning windier and cloudier midweek
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory forecasts mainly fine conditions on Monday under a northeast monsoon, with increasing cloud and occasional light rain later in the week.

zh.headline: 下周初大致天晴 周中風勢轉大雲量增多
zh.dek: 天文台預測周一在東北季候風下大致天晴，周中起風勢增強，雲量逐漸增多，間中有微雨。

en.headline: Woman struck by falling banana while exercising in Kwun Tong estate
en.dek: A woman exercising on a fitness bicycle at Po Pui Court was hit on the head by a banana that fell from above at 7:55 a.m., remaining conscious as she was taken to hospital.

zh.headline: 觀塘寶珮苑晨運婦被高空墮下香蕉砸中頭部送院
zh.dek: 周日早上約7時55分，一名婦人在寶珮苑寶瑛閣對開休憩處踏健身單車時，遭從高處墮下的香蕉砸中頭部，清醒由救護車送院。

en.headline: MPF full portability first phase starts 21 December, covering about one million employees
en.dek: The Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Authority says employees who joined or changed jobs after 1 May 2025 can transfer employer contributions once a calendar year from that date.

zh.headline: 強積金全自由行首階段12月21日實施 涵蓋約100萬僱員
zh.dek: 積金局主席劉麥嘉軒表示，2025年5月1日或之後入職或轉職的僱員，可由該日起每個公曆年一次轉移僱主強制性供款的全數累算權益。

en.headline: Council refers suspected commercial surrogacy case involving mainland influencer to…
en.dek: The Council on Human Reproductive Technology said commercial surrogacy and related advertising are prohibited under the Human Reproductive Technology Ordinance.

zh.headline: 人類生殖科技管理局轉介疑涉商業代孕個案予執法部門
zh.dek: 管理局表示，根據《人類生殖科技條例》，商業代母安排及分發有關廣告屬違法。

en.headline: CityU Power of Play exhibition closes today after three-month run
en.dek: The free show at the Indra and Harry Banga Gallery explores 5,000 years of games from ancient Egypt to esports, with advance online booking required.

zh.headline: 城大「游於藝乎」展覽今日結束 探索五千年遊戲史
zh.dek: 般哥展覽館免費展覽由七月四日起舉行，涵蓋從古埃及到電競的遊戲歷史、藝術與科技，需網上預約。

en.headline: Schools handle average of 496 bullying cases a year, up 32 per cent
en.dek: Education Bureau figures show public schools averaged 496 cases annually from 2022 to 2025, compared with 377 in the previous three years.

zh.headline: 公營中小學年均處理496宗欺凌個案 較前三年增三成二
zh.dek: 教育局數據顯示，2022至2025學年公營學校年均處理496宗欺凌個案，較2019至2022學年的377宗上升32%。

en.headline: Four players share lead into final round of Link Hong Kong Open
en.dek: Thomas Pieters, John Catlin, Anirban Lahiri and Caleb Surratt are tied at 14 under after 54 holes at the Hong Kong Golf Club in Fanling.

zh.headline: 香港公開賽決賽日四名球員並列領先
zh.dek: 湯瑪斯·彼特斯、約翰·卡特林、阿尼爾班·拉希瑞及卡勒伯·蘇拉特在粉嶺香港高爾夫球會三輪後同以低於標準十四桿並列榜首。

en.headline: InnoCarnival 2026 continues at Science Park through 1 November
en.dek: The nine-day free event organised by the Innovation and Technology Commission features aerospace exhibits, workshops and interactive games under the theme Lead with I&T Dream to Fly High.

zh.headline: 創新科技嘉年華2026科學園進行中 至11月1日
zh.dek: 創新科技署主辦的九日免費活動以「創科領航 夢想高飛」為主題，設航天專區、工作坊及互動遊戲。
